data.name: Full-Body Strength, No Equipment
data.description: Two alternating strength workouts, 3×/week, only a chair and sofa. Reps increase from session to session; at the upper limit switch to the harder variation (hint on the exercise).

squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
squat.note: Harder – lower slowly (3 s), pause at the bottom, then split squat.

push_up.name: Push-Ups
push_up.note: Levels – elevated → floor → feet elevated → archer.

pike_push_up.name: Pike Push-up
pike_push_up.note: Hips high, head towards the floor – trains the shoulders.
